Game Overview

Chicken Jockey Plane Runner is a action title where soar through perilous skies as a daring baby zombie on a chicken-steered plane. Navigate voxel landscapes, dodge towering obstacles, and push your reflexes to survive in this heart-pounding, arcade-style escapade that blends Minecraft-inspired charm with high-speed action. Will you master the chaos and emerge victorious?
